Privacy Policy

Strawbridge Property — sole trader, Byron Strawbridge, Isle of Sheppey, ME12. Contact: bstrawbridge@live.co.uk

What data we collect
When you submit an enquiry via this website we collect your name, phone number, email address, site address and job details.

Why we collect it
Solely to respond to your enquiry and provide a quote. We do not use your data for marketing.

Who we share it with
Nobody. Your data is not sold, shared or passed to any third party.

How long we keep it
Enquiry details are kept only as long as needed to complete the job or respond to your request, and no longer than 2 years.

Your rights
Under UK GDPR you have the right to access, correct or request deletion of your personal data at any time. Email us at bstrawbridge@live.co.uk to make a request.

Cookies
This website does not use tracking cookies or analytics.
